eva: Kicking off POC with Northbrook. Trying to reserve dedicated capacity: reserved_gpu_count=4, region=us-west2, az_affinity=us-west2-b. Provisioning is stuck.
sam: What error are you seeing?
eva: infra-bot: POOL_ALLOC_FAILED code=409 msg="Insufficient capacity in us-west2-b" request_id=req_0a1b2c3d
maria: Can you paste the full provisioner logs (last 100 lines)?
eva: ```
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] provisioner: start_reservation id=R-2234 params={gpus:4, region:us-west2, az:us-west2-b}
[2026-03-20T15:02:12Z] cloudapi: AllocateInstance failed status=409 body={\"error\":\"quotaExceeded\",\"message\":\"No capacity in zone\"}
[2026-03-20T15:02:12Z] provisioner: POOL_ALLOC_FAILED id=R-2234 code=POOL_ALLOC_FAILED
```
jon: Looks like the cloud provider returned quotaExceeded for us-west2-b. Their account only has GPU quota in us-west2-a and -c.
maria: Also our scheduler is honoring az_affinity strictness. If az_affinity=strict we won't fallback to other AZs.
sam: So this is both a customer quota issue and a placement policy mismatch.
eva: Customer insists on AZ affinity for data locality. Sales asked: what is the pricing impact if we offer guaranteed-AZ vs any-AZ? Need a number to present.
sam: Quick estimate: guaranteed-AZ reduces pool utilization, so add ~10-20% premium on top of base reserved rate. I'll confirm exact SKU pricing with finance.
alex-sre: Looping infra oncall. @jon @maria can you evaluate a mitigation? infra-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-452 by alex-sre
jon: Short-term workaround: create two smaller pools in us-west2-a and us-west2-c and set reservation_placement_hint="spread" so we split instances across available AZs. Not perfect but gets them live.
eva: Customer ok to try split pools as a temporary measure. They also hit 429s when hammering the provision API: 429 rate_limited: provision_requests_per_min exceeded.
maria: For the POC script, add exponential backoff and cap concurrency to 2. I'll deploy a mitigation to reduce client-retry amplification.
eva: They also submitted security questionnaire Q4.2: "Is inference data routed off-prem?" Answer we gave: for Dedicated, data plane stays in customer VPC; control plane only handles metadata and job orchestration. See: https://redwood.example.com/dedicated-security
jon: I'll run a dry-run with split pools tonight and attach results here.
alex-sre: I'll request a temporary quota bump with cloud provider; ETA 24-48h. If approval comes through we can re-run single-AZ reservation.
eva: Thanks — I'll coordinate with customer and schedule a maintenance window tomorrow 09:00 PT.
maria: Created tracker ENG-7892 with logs and actions (assign: jon). eva: please add customer acceptance to the ticket when they confirm.
sam: :thumbsup:
